title: When the Alibi Turns
author: Felix Dravenmoor
blurb: Paloma Villalobos, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
